note: Administered by Asqav, not IANA. RFC 8726 bars an Independent Submission from creating an IANA registry, so the defining document keeps these as normative tables and points here for administration. Transfer to IANA under Specification Required is expected if the document is progressed on the IETF Stream.

entries.description: A receipt emitted by the acknowledging party ("B") in a counterparty_binding pair under the emitter behaviour of [counterparty-binding-emitter], carrying the counterparty_binding object that digests the bound A-party envelope per [counterparty-binding] - This document.

A receipt recording a policy evaluation outcome (allow, deny, rate_limit) for an MCP-mediated tool call where a policy was actually evaluated; observation is reserved to protectmcp:lifecycle and protectmcp:observation per [decision-fields] - This document.

A receipt recording the application of an enforcement restraint on an agent (e.g., quota, rate limit, sandbox tightening); emission otherwise follows the decision path of [decision-fields] - This document.

A receipt recording an agent or system lifecycle event (e.g., configuration change, key rotation, oversight review, or a decision=observation record indicating an Action was signed without policy evaluation per [decision-fields]) - This document.

A receipt recording a configuration change to an agent or producing system, including changes that disable or re-enable receipt generation (see [art12-1]); a registered sub-namespace under protectmcp:lifecycle that the reference cloud implementation emits today; a receipt of this type that lacks a well-formed config_manifest_digest ([result-bound]) is rejected at signing time per the type-bound presence rule of [result-bound] - This document.

A receipt recording a producer's acceptance of a known risk, security finding, or policy exception; a registered sub-namespace under protectmcp:lifecycle that signs through the no-policy lifecycle path (decision=observation, no policy evaluated) and carries the risk-acceptance extension fields of [risk-acceptance] - This document.

A receipt recording a producer's assertion that an agent-authored change to a code repository existed at a point in time; a registered sub-namespace under protectmcp:lifecycle that signs through the no-policy lifecycle path (decision=observation, no policy evaluated) and carries the code-authorship extension fields of [code-authorship]; the receipt proves only that the change existed, was key-authored, and was chained at the receipt time, and the issuing platform never clones the repository, re-diffs the change, verifies the code, or verifies the model - This document.

A receipt recording passive telemetry about an Action that was signed without a policy evaluation, emitted under one of the capture topologies catalogued in [capture-topologies] (typically network_proxy, browser_extension, ebpf_observer, or mcp_proxy) where the originating application could not call the receipt-emitting SDK directly; the reference cloud implementation rejects at signing time, as the false_attestation_guard, a receipt that declares the passive_telemetry capture topology but carries a type outside protectmcp:observation and its sub-namespaces - This document.

A sub-namespace under protectmcp:observation for a follow-up observation receipt that carries a result_digest ([result-bound]) binding the byte-equality of a downstream Action's result to the originating protectmcp:decision receipt identified by action_ref; the reference cloud implementation emits this type for tool calls whose downstream result is regulator-relevant (LLM completions under EU AI Act Article 12, audit-log entries under HIPAA 164.312(b), broker-dealer communications under SEC 17a-4); a receipt of this type that lacks a well-formed result_digest is rejected at signing time per the type-bound presence rule of [result-bound] - This document.
